description: Awarding the Contract for Widening and Improvement of the road section from 2+900km to 3+736km of the William Gopallawa Mawatha, Kandy to 4 - Lane Standard
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The road section from 2+900km to 3+736 km of the William Gopallawa Mawatha in Kandy, which falls under the purview of the Road Development Authority, is a vital corridor that facilitates daily commuter access and its improvement is essential to enhance urban mobility, reduce traffic congestion and help meet the growing transport needs of the area. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the National Competitive Procurement Procedure for the widening and improvement of the said road section to four-lane standard. 05 bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the above contract to M/s. Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd, the lowest substantially responsive bidder, for a sum of Rs. 696.75 million (excluding VAT) based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
